name: jev
description: A wrapper that gets more value out of TypeSafe's JEV model: transcript compaction, cost-control modes, and a local usage ledger for Claude Code and Codex.

enabled.title: Enable automatic compaction
enabled.description: Turns the session.compact/turn.complete hook on. Off by default. This is the hook's own switch: it cannot read this project's .jev/config.json (the hook sandbox has no filesystem access), so "jev compaction on" in a terminal does not affect it.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key for automated compaction. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history; below it, falls back to Claude Code's built-in compaction.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed.

maxRequests.title: Maximum Jev requests per compaction
maxRequests.description: Ceiling on how many requests one compaction may make. Every request repeats the whole state, so this is the cost multiplier; compaction refuses rather than exceed it.

maxConcurrentRequests.title: Concurrent Jev requests
maxConcurrentRequests.description: How many of those requests run at once.

maxGoalChars.title: Maximum goal characters
maxGoalChars.description: Cap on the task description derived from your recent prompts. Keeps a pasted log in a prompt from making the state unfittable.

requestTimeoutMs.title: Jev request timeout (ms)
requestTimeoutMs.description: A request that does not finish in this long fails, so compaction falls back to the built-in summary instead of hanging.
